output.population: 53 male and 27 female subjects, ages 18 to 76 (mean 46.8 ± 16.7); seventeen are healthy kidney donors scanned prior to nephrectomy and the remaining 65 patients had neither major abdominal pathologies nor pancreatic cancer lesions.
output.summary: Abdominal contrast-enhanced CT scans of subjects without major abdominal pathology, including healthy kidney donors, with manual slice-by-slice pancreas segmentations produced by a medical student and verified by an experienced radiologist.
